methodology.targetVocabulary: One preferred lexical form per eligible lemma; age bands remain heuristic preselection, not acquisition ages.
methodology.segments: All contiguous IPA-unit sequences of length 1 to 5 found inside target pronunciations. These are candidate rebus segments, not asserted linguistic syllables.
methodology.validity: All coverage is exact concatenation of complete visible brick readings. Letters are explicit general-mode operations only.
methodology.candidateSearch: Whole Lexique entries whose complete IPA pronunciation exactly equals an uncovered segment.
methodology.gain: For each prioritized segment, add one virtual exact whole-word brick and count previously unresolved target words that become exactly constructible.
methodology.researchPriority: A separate automatic research score combines coverage gain, segment size and existence of plausible lexical candidates. It is a queueing heuristic only, never a visual-validity score.
methodology.visualCaution: Lexical exactness never implies imageability, spontaneous naming, age suitability, or clinical validation.
